The '''Mountain Storm''' was an exercise in practice [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] involving full splits and an intricate pattern of blade work around the "mountain" of the body, before returning to a standing position using only the thigh muscles. It was possible to smoothly transition into the Mountain Storm from the [[Snake Ascending a Waterfall]].
